item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 3 shot in house in Palmetto, Manatee deputies investigating
item.description: The Manatee County Sheriff’s Office (MCSO) said an investigation is underway after three people were shot in a Palmetto house on Sunday evening.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] ICE expects to equip every field officer with body cameras by end of August
item.description: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement has said it expects every officer and agent to be equipped with a body camera by the end of the month.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Lake Mead hits record low water level as Colorado River concerns grow
item.description: Lake Mead just hit a new record low water level — and Lake Powell is close behind. Here's what the federal government's new Colorado River proposal means for millions of people in the West. 💧
